materials.name: Copper
materials.notes: 100% IACS reference conductivity and density at 20 °C; unit permeability approximation. Temperature dependence is not applied.

materials.name: Benchmark conducting liquid (uncalibrated)
materials.notes: Synthetic EM/fluid nozzle: sigma 2e6 S/m, rho 7000 kg/m3, viscosity 0.002 Pa s, surface tension 0.5 N/m. Constant illustrative liquid properties, not calibrated solder. Five ideal closed current loops; no prescribed fluid force. Isothermal: Joule heat is reported, temperature does not evolve.

materials.name: Sn99.3Cu0.7 molten research properties
materials.notes: Applied at 250.0 C from hardware/solder-properties.json; see its units, sources and limitations. No temperature dependence during this thermal-disabled trial.

materials.name: Permanent magnet
materials.notes: Representative NdFeB: resistivity 160 µΩ·cm, density 7.5 g/cm³. The solver uses μr=1 as an explicit approximation (typical recoil μr≈1.05). Set source magnetization separately per CAD body; no temperature dependence or demagnetization model. Thermal conductivity 9 W/(m K) is an illustrative assumption; heat capacity 450 J/(kg K) is within the vendor range.

materials.name: 316 stainless steel
materials.notes: Density and conductivity references at 20 °C. Unit permeability is an annealed/nonmagnetic approximation; processing can change it. No temperature dependence is applied.

materials.name: Alumina
materials.notes: Representative CoorsTek AD-995 (99.5%) density. Ideal electrical insulator and unit-permeability approximations; room-temperature resistivity exceeds 10¹⁴ Ω·cm. Grade and temperature matter; no temperature dependence is applied.

materials.name: Aluminium 6061 (T6)
materials.notes: Representative 6061-T6 room-temperature properties: density 2700 kg/m³, conductivity 25 MS/m, heat capacity 896 J/(kg K) at 100 °C, thermal conductivity 167 W/(m K). Melting interval 582–652 °C. Unit permeability approximation. Temper/temperature dependence is not modeled; latent heat and liquid viscosity remain unknown.

materials.name: 303/316 stainless screening bracket
materials.notes: Room-temperature resistivity references; conductivity at 250 C is bracketed, not calibrated. Thread/fillet simplifications need refinement.

materials.name: Stationary cold feedstock screening
materials.notes: Fixed feedstock position for one pulse; no replenishment or melting calculation. Electrical conductivity is a solid-solder estimate.
